pr.title: feat(QPBT/Extraction): preserve nonencoding mass bound
pr.body:
### Motivation
- Preserve the existing issue #517 proof from PR #543 against current main
  without reviving superseded Lean modules or old proof holes. The correction
  to the chapter-14 decoding step (lines 1483-1492) needs a separate bound on
  non-encoding polynomial marginal outcomes, documented in
  `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex` and blueprint
  `lem:qld-nonencoding-mass-bound`.

### Description
- Reuse the saved proof of `nonencodingMarginalMass_le` at its identical
  supplied-`GlobalPairWitness` statement; add only its existing support import.
- Mark the existing chapter-16 node as a proved *auxiliary* supplied-witness
  estimate. The main source-facing construction already obtains its witness
  and uses separate proved estimates; it does not call this theorem.
- Update the two stale decoding gap-status statements and restore the dated
  issue-517 audit with original proof provenance and failed-PR-CI history.

### Testing
- Current-head CI passed all nine contexts in 308 seconds on `57da4a91`.
  Blueprint rendering ran; LDT statement-origin was skipped by the changed-path rules.
- The rooted blueprint axiom audit passed 1661 declarations with zero failures
  and three existing statement-level warnings.
- Independent bounded integration review5244004306 approved this head with no
  findings, preserving the first full review5240952565 and F1 recheck5241533460.
  It verified identical changed-content bytes and the surrounding source/blueprint
  integration; it did not repeat the unchanged mathematical proof audit.
- Retained author checks include focused Lean, the targeted Consistency build,
  fresh axiom queries, blueprint rendering/synchronization and normal hooks.
  The unrelated open absorption theorem remains recorded with `sorryAx`.

---
Addresses #517

# Independent bounded integration review - PR 580 @ 57da4a91db7b9336ff76705717409625f7597349

Scope: one fresh review of the full current contribution against its new main context; no repeat of the unchanged mathematical proof audit, no automatic carry. Base/merge-base: `66d359d6fd79e9322f183889390772aa7cfbc87c`. Trusted reviewer policy: `0a2182d59af621ebbd6a36b03c79c77c48566d53`.

Earlier evidence remains visible: full independent code/prose review [5240952565](https://github.com/Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-A/pull/580#pullrequestreview-5240952565) at `4bd78e34` evaluated the proof, source/blueprint statements, and provenance, and raised F1 for missing audit front matter. Independent bounded [F1 recheck 5241533460](https://github.com/Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-A/pull/580#pullrequestreview-5241533460) at `73674f5e` confirmed the front matter and approved; neither is silently reclassified as a review of this head.

## Findings

- none

## Review

The detached worktree is clean at the public head. Independently recomputed the old and new own-patch bodies against their respective merge bases: both are 18,641 bytes, SHA-256 `e4c00a42f3a0b3cff77575277ccda0b9d148762f8e5afe2995578350e4ce5564`. Full normalized diffs, which retain context after stripping only index/hunk-header lines, differ (31,550 vs 31,471 bytes); hence this is an independent bounded context review, not a strict carry. The PR's Lean file, historical audit, decoding note and its decoding register row are unchanged since `73674f5e`; main's intervening extraction support changed the chapter-16 context and the neighboring extraction-transfer register row.

In current context, `nonencodingMarginalMass_le` (`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Consistency.lean:693`) still explicitly quantifies over a supplied `GlobalPairWitness`, with one universal constant, both player sides, and both Pauli bases. Chapter-16 `lem:qld-nonencoding-mass-bound` calls it a formalization-only supplied-witness estimate; its statement and proof marks certify that auxiliary only. The current decoder gap note and decoding register row preserve that scope and distinguish the source-facing `exists_pulled_apart_consistency`, which constructs a witness and uses other specialized estimates, from this auxiliary. The new main-side `exists_extractionWitness` in `Extraction/SourceUnitary.lean` separately composes a global constructor and a conditional extraction theorem; its chapter-16 node and extraction-transfer register row do not claim to use or discharge `nonencodingMarginalMass_le`. The later isometry range-projection transfer remains open. The source's unrestricted decoder substitution at `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1483-1492` is still documented as false, not asserted by the new auxiliary. The inherited `sorry` in `Consistency.lean:650` is unrelated to this theorem.

Prior F1 remains resolved: the audit begins with `title`, `date`, `purpose`, `issue`, and `pr` YAML fields, and its body after the ten-line header has the same SHA-256 `d3cf172f5bb5c12bf1bfab3b8b3dedcf7f5fb47cb81b4b9081a2eac77b0c4eb4` as at `4bd78e34`. It retains PR 543's failed build-lock/blueprint-sync attempt and absent review as historical failures rather than claiming their success.

Exact-head GitHub CI read through the primary `gh_common.py` reports all nine `local-ci/*` contexts successful, including build, blueprint render/sync, proof-debt and proof-evasion (summary: 308 seconds). `git diff --check` passed. No new Lean elaboration, full build, CI or whole-proof review was run for this bounded recheck; the earlier proof/axiom evidence and current exact-head CI are used within their stated scope.

VERDICT: APPROVED

pr.title: feat(QPBT/Combining): Preserve finite quadratic POVM obstruction
pr.body:
### Motivation

Issue #511: retain PR #547's closed finite POVM / root-count packet on current
main while leaving the current source-facing constructions and gap context
intact. PR #547 and its branch are untouched by this PR and remain open; this
branch is a fresh replacement built on published main.

### Description

- Preserve the quadratic point witness, the affine / `Option`-completed /
  uniform POVM defect bounds, and the eight-element `21/32` scalar result in a
  new module `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/QuadraticPointObstruction.lean`
  (eleven unique declarations retained, statements unchanged).
- Reuse merged PR #299's deterministic measurement and effect APIs
  (`deterministicMeasurement`, `deterministicMeasurement_projective` in
  `Test/Completeness/HonestStrategy/MeasurementFamily.lean`, and
  `Measurement.postprocess_comp`) instead of the three generic duplicates the
  saved packet carried. No shared-helper move, no import cycle, and no change
  to `Combining/Apply.lean`, `PointErrorObstruction.lean`, the paper mirrors or
  the blueprint chapters.
- Archive PR #547's original cost and audit record byte-for-byte (116-line,
  6524-byte suffix) under a valid YAML header in
  `audits/2026-09-12_issue511-independent-finite-obstruction.md`.
- Add a limited current-status cross-reference to the existing paper-gap note
  `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex`.

Scope is deliberately narrow: these are auxiliary, formalization-only
obstruction results. No full line-law transport, no source theorem, and no
blueprint `\leanok` is claimed; the `21/256` X-axis mixture contribution stays
prose, and the three open `Apply.lean` statements are untouched.

### Testing

- Current-head CI passed all nine contexts in 248 seconds on `1086ce4c`.
  Blueprint rendering and LDT statement-origin were skipped by changed-path rules.
- The rooted blueprint axiom audit passed 1659 declarations with zero failures
  and three existing statement-level warnings.
- Independent bounded recheck5243960797 approved the corrected docstring locator
  and unchanged contribution. Its focused Lean check passed without diagnostics.
  The first full review5243849416 supplies the mathematical and provenance review.
- Retained author checks include the targeted module/root checks, standard-only
  axiom probes, paper-gap and blueprint checks, and normal commit/push hooks.
  The eleven obstruction contracts and historical records keep their stated scope.

---

Addresses issue #511 without closing it; issue #511 and PR #547 stay open until
this replacement is integrated.

# Review - PR 587 @ 1086ce4c9aa5febc5d5acf026753f03757d2ce4e

Bounded recheck by an independent Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused, and the approved mathematics and prose evidence of review 5243849416 at head 6d79bfcf stands. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 0a2182d59af621ebbd6a36b03c79c77c48566d53. Since that review the branch gained a conflict-free merge of main and one docstring-only commit (1086ce4c, +2/-1 comment lines in MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/QuadraticPointObstruction.lean); the main-relative change is still the same four files, 475 insertions and 7 deletions against merge base 0a2182d5 on base branch main.

## Findings

- none

## Review

Scope of this recheck, as directed: the F1 reference fix, the invariance of the rest of the PR's own patch, and exact-head CI. I did not repeat the mathematical or prose review of the preservation packet itself.

F1 is resolved and the new locator is correct. The docstring References block at MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/QuadraticPointObstruction.lean:18-20 now reads `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex`, subsection "The extended-line supplied-point obstruction" (the quadratic material is at lines 255-320). At this head that file contains `\subsection{The extended-line supplied-point obstruction}` at exactly docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex:215, the subsection runs to the next `\section` at :325, and the quadratic argument begins at :255 ("The extended point answer is $\alpha x^2$") and runs through the footnote naming this very module at :313, so both the heading and the line range resolve. The stale string "Unrestricted point witnesses" no longer occurs anywhere in the file. The other three references in the same block (the two `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex` locators and the two blueprint labels) are untouched by this commit.

Nothing else changed. I compared the PR's own main-relative patch at both heads: `git diff $(git merge-base github/main 6d79bfcf) 6d79bfcf` versus `git diff $(git merge-base github/main 1086ce4c) 1086ce4c` differ only in the three lines of that docstring hunk plus the accompanying blob hash and line-count metadata (27530 vs 27563 bytes; added-file length 314 -> 315). The intervening merge commit db1b9b4d brought in only main's five `chore(telemetry): hourly batch` commits 66d359d6..0a2182d5 and resolved without conflict, so no Lean statement, definition, proof, audit or blueprint-facing text moved. The merged-in diff contains no `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, `native_decide` or `set_option` line. The subject of 1086ce4c is 68 characters, `type(scope): imperative` form, no fix-prefix and no closing reference; the worktree HEAD equals the published head and is clean.

Verification. Exact-head CI via `gh api repos/Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-A/commits/1086ce4c.../status` is `state: success` with all nine contexts success: local-ci/build, blueprint-render, blueprint-sync, file-length, paper-gaps, proof-debt, proof-evasion, statement-origin and local-ci/summary. I also re-ran `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/QuadraticPointObstruction.lean` in the PR worktree at this head: exit 0, no diagnostics.

Not checked (deliberately, per the bounded scope): the eleven declarations' mathematics, the duplication-against-main survey, the archived audit and the gap-note prose, all of which were checked and approved at 6d79bfcf by review 5243849416 and are byte-identical here; and no full `lake build` (CI's build step is green at this head) and no `#print axioms` re-derivation.

VERDICT: APPROVED (code=APPROVED, prose=APPROVED)
